reviewed_candidates.credit_policy: No equivalence exemption. The original definition is retained and killed as O01-06; O01-05 separately disables the total deadline.
reviewed_candidates.initial_equivalence_reason: Changing remaining <= 0 to remaining <= -1 sends a nonpositive remaining timeout to asyncio.wait_for. For a standard asynchronous ASGI receive coroutine, wait_for immediately raises TimeoutError without running receive, and the middleware returns the same 408. The externally observable deadline behavior is unchanged.
reviewed_candidates.reason: The local Starlette Receive type is Callable[[], Awaitable[Message]], so a buffered receive can return a pre-resolved Future. asyncio.wait_for returns such an already-completed result even with a nonpositive timeout. With -0.5 seconds remaining, the original <= 0 guard rejects with 408, whereas <= -1 admits the completed body and dispatches the app. An independent buffered-awaitable deadline test therefore distinguishes the original mutation without a timeout or setup error.
